radar.headline: Custom Leather Patches: test the business before scaling it.
radar.headlineZh: 定制皮革章：扩大投入前，先验证商业模型。
radar.answer: Low material cost and short engraving cycles make patches a practical way to test niches and repeat wholesale orders.
radar.answerZh: 低材料成本和短雕刻周期，让皮革章适合测试细分市场并承接重复批发订单。
radar.action: Review demand, margin, production speed, and the evidence collected from real paid tests.
radar.actionZh: 复盘需求、利润、生产速度，以及真实付费测试获得的证据。
radar.caveat: Planning estimates only. Fees, labor, failed units, packaging, shipping, tax, and marketing may not be included.
